parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH to 8 dropped val_bpb from 0.999229 to 0.982615. The extra capacity is paying off. Now that we've established depth works, I'll try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to further improve the model's architectural efficiency and resolution capabilities.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 (from 6) and increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to further increase model capacity and structural information density.
